_readme: Approximate cost of a sewage pumping station (SPS / IPS) for comparing zoning options at PFR stage - NOT a DPR estimate. User decision 12-Oct-2026: there is no rule per MLD for pumping stations; they are worked out from their civil, mechanical and electrical parts, so a logical approximate cost is made now and checked properly when the DPR is made. The cost of each part follows the THREE pumping stations of the user's DPR files (data_points): for every E&M part and for the civil works, cost = A x (Q / 639 L/s)^e fitted through Riverside SPS-1 and the mean of the two Lakeside SPS (pumping.fit); a part that does not grow with the flow in these data (e < 0) is taken as the mean of the three. Civil works follow the depth (deep structures share); brought to one depth, the civil cost of the three stations hardly changes with the flow. Values marked 'assumed' are Claude's engineering assumptions - verify.

Riverside SPS-1.source: SPSorIPS.xlsx (BOQ SPS1, DESIGN DATA SPS, INLET CHAMBER SPS) + abstract .xlsx (BREAKUP OF COST 1) - Riverside zone, AMRUT 2.0, Springfield
Riverside SPS-1.capacity_note: peak flow incl. 10 % infiltration, design year 2057

Lakeside SPS-1 + SPS-2.source: this file to imrove ips rates.pdf - appraisal note (CE Westbrook zone) of 29-08-2025, Lakeside zone sewer network, AMRUT 2.0, Springfield: A4 SPS-1 11 MLD 294.56, A5 SPS-2 4 MLD 325.09; B E&M of SPS-1 & SPS-2 together (2 jobs); power connection charge for SPS 1 & 2 162.15 lakh
Lakeside SPS-1 + SPS-2.capacity_note: peak flow of the ultimate (design) year - user, 12-Oct-2026
Lakeside SPS-1 + SPS-2.depth_note: inlet chamber height 7.57 m (SPS-1) and 9.84 m (SPS-2) - lakeside 2sps.pdf (Estimate for proposed SPS-1 / SPS 2, item 1 INLET CHAMBER) - minus chamber_extra_height_m 1.3 m (the Riverside relation)

deep_share.note: share of the civil cost in structures as deep as the incoming sewer (wet well 125.70 + inlet chamber 29.28 + coarse screen chambers 152.90 of 395.40 lakh, Riverside BOQ); scaled by (depth + chamber_extra_height_m) / (10.74 + chamber_extra_height_m). The Lakeside civil costs are brought to the Riverside depth with this factor before the fit

ht_threshold_kw.note: all three pumping stations of the DPRs have an HT supply + substation (even the 4 MLD one) - so always HT; set a kW here to use an LT connection below it

lt_connection_lakh.note: LT service connection when no HT supply is taken (only with ht_threshold_kw > 0)

power_connection_lakh.note: per SPS = Lakeside 162.15 / 2 (not shown in the Riverside files)

connected_load_factor.note: connected kW = working pump kW x this (standby pumps, screens, lights)

inlet_drop_m.note: IL of inlet chamber = incoming invert - 0.3 m (Riverside INLET CHAMBER SPS, CPHEEO)

wet_well_retention_s.note: effective volume = 5 min of peak flow (Riverside: 9.9 m dia - drawn 10 m); for the report only

rising_main_head_m.note: delivery + friction of the rising main when its length is not known; with the STP given, the rising main is sized and its friction computed (rising_main.py)

tariff_rs_per_kwh.note: UPPCL tariff for the connection - verify

om_em_fraction.note: yearly staff + maintenance = this x E&M capex ...

stp_lakh_per_mld.note: user, 12-Oct-2026: STP Rs 1.5 crore per MLD (Lakeside appraisal: STP 10 MLD = 1500 lakh)
